title: Roots on the Graph
brief:
plots: y = 2x² – 5x + 3, as a line chart with markers
x values: 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3
series 'y': 3.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 3.0, 6.0
html:
<script>
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 3], y: [-1, 7], xLabel: "x", yLabel: "y" });
let x = 0;
const f = t => 2 * t * t - 5 * t + 3;
const data = [0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3].map(t => [t, f(t)]);

function draw() {
  c.clear();
  c.fn(t => f(t), { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });
  c.line(data);
  c.dots(data);
  const y = f(x);
  c.vline(x);
  c.dots([[x, y]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  c.label(x + 0.12, y + 0.5, `x = ${x}`);
  c.readout([
    `x = ${x}`,
    `y = ${y.toFixed(1)}`,
    y === 0 ? "y = 0: x is a root" : `y = ${y.toFixed(1)}, not a root`
  ]);
  Visual.state(`At x = ${x}, y = 2x² – 5x + 3 = ${y.toFixed(1)}${y === 0 ? ", so x is a root" : ""}`);
}

Visual.on("x", v => { x = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
